$comment: § Language, declared once. .ai/standards/ui-design-system.md § Language is the standard; this
file is the state its two enforcement mechanisms share, in the shape .ai/registry/boundaries.json
already uses for RULE-02 — one declaration, two consumers, so neither can drift from the other.
Consumed by eslint.config.js (the lint rule) and tests/ui-language.test.ts (the half a lint rule
cannot express). It is NOT in .ai/registry/: copyDebt changes every time a ticket translates a
file, and the registry is for things that need an ADR to move.
copyDebt only ever SHRINKS. It is a ratchet, not a suppression list: twelve files predated the
standard, OPS-001 translated seven and OPS-002 the last five, and THE LIST IS NOW EMPTY — which
is the standard's own stated proof that the sweep is complete. It must stay empty: adding a file
here is the failure mode, and it is now the only way this list can change. tests/ui-language.test.ts
fails when an entry no longer has copy to translate, so a paid debt cannot stay listed.
userContent is PERMANENT and means the opposite. Those files must CONTAIN diacritics — they are
the standard's stated exception and the product's only coverage for the type requirement in
CLAUDE.md § Visual direction. Never move an entry from userContent into copyDebt.
